verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's features page lists speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and hands-free voice and video calls, which covers transcription, spoken replies, and live voice conversation. The voice-and-audio docs add sentence-by-sentence streaming read-aloud and a hands-free loop where you talk, the AI answers, and the reply is read back. Missing for 10: in-depth main-product docs on speech-to-text and voice-note transcription (the detailed pages sit under the Computer ecosystem section), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported

citations.quote: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls
Responses are read aloud sentence by sentence as they stream, so playback starts before the response finishes.
Hands-free conversation: you talk, the AI answers, the reply is read back
